title: Event
description: Complete DB-row-to-JSON serialization contract for the current committed PostgreSQL events table using the repository's default node-postgres text parsers followed by JSON.stringify/parse. It is an offline export/inspection boundary, not a runtime route DTO or event-create request schema; workspace authorization for new writes remains enforced by application checks and RLS.

id.description: BIGSERIAL primary key returned by the default pg INT8 text parser as a precision-safe decimal string.

group_id.description: Tenant namespace. Migration 19 enforces the strict format check.

workspace_id.description: Stored workspace scope added by migration 39. SQL NULL represents a quarantined legacy row; workspace-governed writes must persist a non-empty value and are enforced by restrictive RLS.

event_type.description: Operation type. PostgreSQL enforces non-empty VARCHAR(100), not a closed enum; emitted vocabulary is documented separately.

created_at.description: TIMESTAMPTZ parsed by pg as Date and emitted by JSON serialization as an ISO date-time string.

agent_id.description: Identifier of the agent or user who triggered the event.

step_id.description: Nullable step identifier within a workflow.

parent_event_id.description: Nullable BIGINT parent reference returned by pg as a precision-safe decimal string.

metadata.description: Nullable JSONB event payload. JSONB permits any JSON value; SQL NULL and JSON null both serialize as JSON null.

outcome.description: Nullable JSONB outcome payload. JSONB permits any JSON value; SQL NULL and JSON null both serialize as JSON null.

inserted_at.description: TIMESTAMPTZ audit insertion time serialized from pg Date to an ISO date-time string.

evidence_ref.description: Nullable evidence source reference added by migration 05.

confidence.description: Nullable DECIMAL(4,3) confidence returned by the default pg NUMERIC parser as a decimal string.

runtime.description: Nullable runtime label added by migration 10; default unknown does not make the physical column NOT NULL.

session_id.description: Nullable session identifier added by migration 10.

schema_version.description: NOT NULL INTEGER event schema version added by migration 17; default 1.
